script:
set -eu
for tool in nix python3; do
  if ! command -v "$tool" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "Missing required bare sandbox tool: $tool" >&2
    echo "The iteration workflow uses $tool before or outside bin/dev's devenv shell. Rebuild the Fabro sandbox image with this tool on the default PATH." >&2
    exit 1
  fi
done
if [ ! -x bin/dev ]; then
  echo "Missing or non-executable bin/dev" >&2
  exit 1
fi
rm -rf .fabro/tmp
sed -i 's/set -euo pipefail/set -euo pipefail\nset -x/' bin/dev
set +e
PATH="$PWD/bin:$PATH" bin/dev sandbox-check > /tmp/sandbox-trace.log 2>&1
status=$?
tail -160 /tmp/sandbox-trace.log
exit $status
command:
exec 2>&1
set -eu
for tool in nix python3; do

    echo "The iteration workflow uses $tool before or outside bin/dev's devenv shell. Rebuild the Fabro sandbox image with this tool on the default PATH." >&2
    exit 1
  fi
done
if [ ! -x bin/dev ]; then
  echo "Missing or non-executable bin/dev" >&2
  exit 1
fi
rm -rf .fabro/tmp
sed -i 's/set -euo pipefail/set -euo pipefail\nset -x/' bin/dev
set +e
PATH="$PWD/bin:$PATH" bin/dev sandbox-check > /tmp/sandbox-trace.log 2>&1
status=$?
tail -160 /tmp/sandbox-trace.log
exit $status
